note: Bounded role x capability matrix. Repository roles are: super_admin, admin_operations, admin_finance, admin_security, admin_readonly, tenant_owner, staff, technician, customer, guest (confirmed live via JWT role claims and ROLE_PERMISSIONS this sprint and in MODULE-L5-00A). The mission's suggested canonical set (platform_admin, support_admin, manager) does NOT exist as distinct repository roles -- explicit mapping below, not silently collapsed.

role_mapping.platform_admin: NOT A DISTINCT REPOSITORY ROLE -- closest real equivalent is super_admin (P.ALL wildcard)
role_mapping.support_admin: NOT A DISTINCT REPOSITORY ROLE -- closest real equivalent is admin_readonly (0-mutation, broad read access) for general support; admin_security for session/device support cases
role_mapping.tenant_admin: NOT A DISTINCT REPOSITORY ROLE -- closest real equivalent is tenant_owner (this codebase does not distinguish tenant_admin from tenant_owner)
role_mapping.manager: NOT A DISTINCT REPOSITORY ROLE -- no manager role or permission bundle found in app/core/permissions.py this sprint
role_mapping.technician: technician (exact match) -- CONFIRMED distinct from staff: require_technician() and require_staff_or_above() are separate functions with different allowed-role sets in app/dependencies/auth.py
role_mapping.guest: guest -- CONFIRMED not merely unauthenticated noise: appears as a real Literal role value and in role-module matrix (MODULE-L5-00A) as a distinct actor for read-only/system-trigger-only capabilities (e.g. serviceability pre-check, public catalog browse)
